title: limonium vulgare subsp. pseudolimonium
intro: Limonium vulgare subsp. pseudolimonium, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Statice, is a perennial plant species in the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, may contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat skin conditions, including wounds, burns, and eczema, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
